title: Windswept Pine
body:
Description

The Windswept Pine Tree (cased to WindSwept Pine in game) is a windswept tree ubiquitous to the Acidlands. Other trees that can be found alongside the Windswept Pine Trees are the Willow Trees.

In characteristics, it is mainly grey in colour, specifically of the hex code #505050. Its tree form has rather unique leaves, with them being of a darker colour and its shape form being "windswept", hence the tree's name. The tree's textures are the default texture used in most common trees.

Along with most items in the game, the Windswept Pine tree can be used to fill schematics and blueprints.

Availability

It is accessible by the use of Steel Tools, notably the Steel Axe and the Steel Saw.
